notes.title: 我们参加了“飞机、火车和汽车”游戏节！
notes.content:
[h3]各位玩家们~大家中秋快乐！[/h3]
准备好踏上两段充满[b]情感与回忆[/b]的列车旅程了吗？

我们工作室发行的两款以列车为主题的叙事游戏，
《最后列车》和《第七号列车》，现已加入Steam[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/category/plane_train_autos]“飞机、火车和汽车”游戏节[/url][/b]！
这两款游戏都以列车为主题，讲述了动人的故事。还没体验过它们的小伙伴欢迎来试一试！

[hr][/hr]
[h3]《最后列车 - The Last Train》[/h3]
在濒临灭亡的荒芜大地上，最后一辆驶向地面的列车出发了。乘客们将踏上一段充满希望与分别的旅程，寻找生存之地。在这个故事中，你将跟随主角Eilf，与神秘的生物伙伴一起，搜集资源，探究这个世界的秘密，前往已经消失的终点站——春天。

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2456860/__The_Last_Train/

[hr][/hr]
[h3]《第七号列车 - Train No. 7》[/h3]
这是一部以“海龟汤”式解谜为核心的剧情向文字游戏。原本是一趟平静的旅程，却因一位独自旅行的少女的故事而逐渐充满悬念。随着少女慢慢敞开心扉，旅途中的“你”将逐步揭开背后的真相。

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1708870/__Train_No_7/

这两款游戏的故事都与“列车”和“旅途”有关，并广受玩家好评中！
[h3]如果你喜欢感人的叙事和独特的列车题材，

不要错过这两款游戏~快来体验吧！ːcharmedː[/h3]

梦结界工作室
2024.9.17

Carbontea & Eternal Dream Studio

notes.title: The Last Train: Major Update Preview
notes.content:
Hi, dear players! Here is Carbontea, the developer of this game. Thank you for all your support of The Last Train! This news is a teaser for a major update coming to The Last Train.

[b]The Last Train will be updated on July 26. The update will be available in both English version and the Art Book DLC, and will be released by Eternal Dream Studio. [/b]
[b]The English version was completed by the hard work of the translators. The following is our English localization team list:[/b]
English version translation: Yuning YANG; FauxFur; Johnny Liu; Shibei Ding; Hope
English version test: Zorzamoth; Shibei Ding; FauxFur; MoriP; Yuning YANG; Barbara; Ciaran
Publisher assistance: LillethGod；LemonadeHuiHui；C14sama；ChemistryChanAzumi

I'd like to give a special thanks to these translators and testers for their voluntary efforts and support for the game!

In addition, future updates will also make some adjustments to the game content:

[b]About this update[/b]
1. This update adds an English option. You can select the language on the initial game interface.
2. If you have the game save file, press X on the main interface, select Delete save file, and then you can select the language.
3. If you have the game save file, the update may cause some problems such as texture errors, which can be solved by restarting the game or deleting the save file.

[b]Modifications and adjustments[/b]
1. Fixed and adjusted some text content;
2. Adjusted the display and layout of some UI components;
3. Fixed some archive issues.

[b]Function adjustment[/b]
Adjusted the operation method of the game buttons.
Old version: Z key is used to trigger and accelerate the conversation;
New version: Z key is used to trigger the conversation, and X key is used to accelerate the conversation.

[b]Some known common BUGs (not fixed yet) [/b]
1. The in-game dialogues may be stuck, triggered off-site or repeatedly;
2. The in-game screen may be torn or stuck;
3. The screen flickers when the resolution is set on the main interface in the game.

The above BUGs or game stucks have not been fixed yet. When triggered, they can be solved by restarting the game or avoiding fast operations.

If there are other BUGs when running the game, or there are any game-related issues, you can provide feedback or communication in the following ways.

Official Discord channels:[url=https://discord.gg/pwzPTvgfgz]discord[/url]

Thank you for your patience and support!

notes.title: The Last Train is expected to be released in English in the summer!
notes.content:
[b]Hi, players! Thank you for your support of The Last Train. I'm Carbontea, the developer for this game. This news is about the localization of this game. [/b]

Thanks to the efforts of the translators, the English version of this game is expected to be released in July.
We are currently recruiting LQA testers for the English version. As a free game, this job is also done with love. The names of the participants will be marked in the game production list and Steam news. 
If you are interested, please contact me through the [b]message at the bottom[/b]!

[b]Localization progress: [/b]
All texts in the game have been proofread and polished by the translators. Now feedback and testing are needed, which is LQA.
[b]Time and workload: [/b]
The LQA phase will start this month and will take about 20-30 days.
A total of 3-5 friends are required to participate, using tools such as Google Sheet to upload feedback and check translation files, and Discord communication. The game is only available on Windows platform.
The game process takes about 3-4 hours, and a single chapter takes about 1-2 hours. Participants may need to test the game content repeatedly.
[b]Requirements: [/b]
Participants are best to have English localization experience. If you have no translation experience, but have a high level of English and confidence are also welcome to participate us. The test process may require you to play the English version of the game process multiple times, carefully check the text in the game and provide feedback.

So the most important thing is that I hope you are interested in this game!

[b]You can find my contact information through the channels below↓ [/b]

Official QQ: 429372906
Email: clionelimacina2022@qq.com

Disocrd: https://discord.gg/t7cbunQA
